**司机分层TSH**

```plain
with dri_tsh_type as  
    (
        select distinct 
        a.*
        ,b.id_card_no_md5
        ,c.exp_group
        ,max(tsh_type) over(partition by concat(b.id_card_no_md5, c.exp_group)) as dri_type
        from (
        select distinct 
            dt,
            driver_id,
            city_id,
            city_name,
            company_id,
            case
                when company_id = 1400 then '自营'
                when company_id <> 1400 then '宏鹄'
                else null
            end as type,
            case
                when work_time_period_30d in ('240h+', '(200-240h]') then 2
                when work_time_period_30d in ('(0-40h]','(40-80h]','(80-120h]') then 0
                when work_time_period_30d in ('(160-200h]','(120-160h]') then 1
                else null
            end as tsh_type,
            case
                when right_type = 'default_driver' then '默认等级'
                when right_type = 'full_time_driver' then '先锋司机/长期伙伴'
                when right_type = 'semi_fulltime_driver' then '半全职'
                when right_type = 'full_time_plus_driver' then '权益plus'
                else null
            end as right_type
        from
            kflower_app.dm_hh_dri_right_driver_detail_index_di
        where
            dt between '2025-12-17' and '2025-12-24'
            and city_id in (58)
        ) a 
        left join 
            (
                select 
                    dt    
                    ,driver_id
                    ,max(id_card_no_md5) id_card_no_md5
                from 
                    kflower_app.dm_hh_dri_st_driver_info_idcard_di
                where 
                    dt between '2025-12-17' and '2025-12-24'
                group by  
                    dt    
                    ,driver_id
            )b  
        on a.driver_id = b.driver_id and a.dt = b.dt
    left join 
    (
    select
        distinct apollo_key,
        group_name as exp_group,
        dims ['city'] as dim_city,
        concat_ws('-', year, month, day) as ymd
    from
        apollo.pre_flow_data_etl
    where concat_ws('-', year, month, day) between '2025-12-17' and '2025-12-24'
    and   exp = 'hxz_dispatch_type_optimization_v1'
    and group_name in ('control_group', 'treatment_group')
    ) c on a.driver_id = c.apollo_key
    and a.city_id = c.dim_city
    and a.dt = c.ymd
    )

select 
exp_group
,right_type
,count(distinct id_card_no_md5) as dri_cnt
,avg(tsh) avg_tsh
from (
select 
exp_group
,id_card_no_md5
,right_type
,sum(online_dur) tsh
from (
select 
a.dt
,driver_id
,sum(online_dur) online_dur
from 
(
select 
dt
,driver_id
,unix_timestamp(first_online_time) as f_ts
,unix_timestamp(first_online_time) as l_ts
,online_dur
from 
kflower_dw.dwm_kf_dri_online_di
where dt between '2025-12-17' and '2025-12-24'
) a group by 
dt, driver_id
) a
inner join dri_tsh_type c
on a.driver_id = c.driver_id
and a.dt = c.dt
group by 
exp_group
,right_type
,id_card_no_md5
) t group by 
exp_group
,right_type;

```
司机分层完单漏斗
```plain
with dri_tsh_type as  
    (
        select distinct 
        a.*
        ,b.id_card_no_md5
        ,c.exp_group
        ,max(tsh_type) over(partition by concat(b.id_card_no_md5, c.exp_group)) as dri_type
        from (
        select distinct 
            dt,
            driver_id,
            city_id,
            city_name,
            company_id,
            case
                when company_id = 1400 then '自营'
                when company_id <> 1400 then '宏鹄'
                else null
            end as type,
            case
                when work_time_period_30d in ('240h+', '(200-240h]') then 2
                when work_time_period_30d in ('(0-40h]','(40-80h]','(80-120h]') then 0
                when work_time_period_30d in ('(160-200h]','(120-160h]') then 1
                else null
            end as tsh_type,
            case
                when right_type = 'default_driver' then '默认等级'
                when right_type = 'full_time_driver' then '先锋司机/长期伙伴'
                when right_type = 'semi_fulltime_driver' then '半全职'
                when right_type = 'full_time_plus_driver' then '权益plus'
                else null
            end as right_type
        from
            kflower_app.dm_hh_dri_right_driver_detail_index_di
        where
            dt between '2025-12-17' and '2025-12-24'
            and city_id in (58)
        ) a 
        left join 
            (
                select 
                    dt    
                    ,driver_id
                    ,max(id_card_no_md5) id_card_no_md5
                from 
                    kflower_app.dm_hh_dri_st_driver_info_idcard_di
                where 
                    dt between '2025-12-17' and '2025-12-24'
                group by  
                    dt    
                    ,driver_id
            )b  
        on a.driver_id = b.driver_id and a.dt = b.dt
    left join 
    (
    select
        distinct apollo_key,
        group_name as exp_group,
        dims ['city'] as dim_city,
        concat_ws('-', year, month, day) as ymd
    from
        apollo.pre_flow_data_etl
    where concat_ws('-', year, month, day) between '2025-12-17' and '2025-12-24'
    and   exp = 'hxz_dispatch_type_optimization_v1'
    and group_name in ('control_group', 'treatment_group')
    ) c on a.driver_id = c.apollo_key
    and a.city_id = c.dim_city
    and a.dt = c.ymd
    )

select 
exp_group
,broad.city_id
,right_type
,count(distinct if(cancel_cnt = 0 , concat(b.id_card_no_md5, broad.dt), null)) / count(distinct concat(b.id_card_no_md5, broad.dt)) as d_rate
,count(distinct handup.order_id) / count(distinct broad.order_id) as handup
,count(distinct if(is_td_answer = 1, broad.order_id, null)) / count(distinct broad.order_id) as ar
,count(distinct if(is_td_finish = 1, broad.order_id, null)) / count(distinct broad.order_id) as cr
,count(distinct if(is_grab_after_pas_cancel = 1, broad.order_id, null)) / count(distinct if(is_td_answer = 1, broad.order_id, null)) as pas_cancel
,count(distinct if(is_grab_after_dri_cancel = 1 or is_td_reassign = 1, broad.order_id, null)) / count(distinct if(is_td_answer = 1, broad.order_id, null)) as dri_cancel
,count(distinct if(is_td_finish = 1, broad.order_id, null)) / count(distinct concat(b.id_card_no_md5, broad.dt)) as fin_cnt
from 
(
select 
a.*
,b.driver_id as base_driver_id
from (
select
distinct 
concat_ws('-', year, month, day) as dt
,param ['orderid'] as order_id
,param ['area'] as city_id
,param ['driverid'] as driver_id
,param ['base_passenger_id'] as passenger_id
,param ['DispatchType'] as dispatch_type
,param['broad_source'] as broad_source
,if(param ['is_serial_order']=1, 1, 0) as is_serial_order
,param ['lumian_dis'] as lumian_dis
from
kflower_marketplace.ods_log_kflower_orderbroadcast_hh
where
concat_ws('-', year, month, day) between '2025-12-17' and '2025-12-24'
and param['broad_source'] in ('hh_hxz_stg', 'hh_hxz_speed')
and (param['is_home_dispatch'] is null or param['is_home_dispatch'] = 0)
and param['is_online'] = 1
and param['order_origin'] <> 2
-- and param['is_serial_order'] = 0
--and hour >= 17
--and param ['DispatchType'] in (1,2,3)
--and param ['anycar_type'] in (1,2,5)
and param ['area'] in (58)
) a left join 
(
select distinct 
       driverid as driver_id,
       driver_id_3rd_part_str as driver_3rd,
       cpid
from kflower_ods.ods_log_kflower_g_order_strivetender
where concat_ws('-',year,month,day) between '2025-12-17' and '2025-12-24'
and iscontinue = 'true'  and filter_rule_num = 'R0'
and is_honghu_driver = 'true'  
) b on a.driver_id = b.driver_3rd
) broad
left join 
(
select distinct
        param ['orderid'] as order_id  
        ,param ['driverid'] as driver_id
        ,param ['left_cancel'] as cancel_cnt 
    from
        kflower_marketplace.ods_log_kflower_stgmatrix_hh --matrix日志
    where
        concat_ws('-', year, month, day) between '2025-12-17' and '2025-12-24'
    and param['broad_source'] in ('hh_hxz_stg', 'hh_hxz_speed')
    and param['is_online'] = 1
    -- and param['is_serial_order'] = 0
    --and (param ['is_serial_order'] is null or param ['is_serial_order'] = 0)
) feature
on broad.order_id = feature.order_id
and broad.driver_id = feature.driver_id
left join (
        select distinct 
       lowoid as order_id,
       driverid as driver_id,
       driver_id_3rd_part_str as driver_3rd,
       cpid
from kflower_ods.ods_log_kflower_g_order_strivetender
where concat_ws('-',year,month,day) between '2025-12-17' and '2025-12-24'
and iscontinue = 'true'  and filter_rule_num = 'R0'
and is_honghu_driver = 'true'
and ((cpid = 1373
        and channelid = 3)
        or  (cpid = 1017
        and (channelid = 2 or channelid = 1)))
) handup
on broad.order_id = handup.order_id
and broad.driver_id = handup.driver_3rd
left join(
     select
            start_city_id
            ,hour(call_time) as tid 
            ,order_id
            ,driver_id
            ,source_id
            ,is_td_call
            ,is_td_answer
            ,is_td_finish
            ,is_td_cancel
            ,is_grab_after_pas_cancel
            ,is_grab_after_dri_cancel
            ,is_td_reassign
            ,est_arrive_dis
            ,gmv_amt as gmv -- 单位元
            ,is_pbd
            ,is_hxz
            ,product_id
            ,platform_name
            ,answer_time
            ,cancel_time
            ,call_reassign_order_id
            ,answer_reassign_order_id
        from
            kflower_dw.dwd_kf_trd_unity_order_di
        where 
            dt between '2025-12-17' and '2025-12-24'
            and (is_pbd = 1 or is_hxz = 1 or is_thlm = 1)
            -- and product_id <> 384 -- 剔除小猪端的滴滴
            and (is_td_answer = 1 or is_td_finish = 1)
            and product_id in (80,77)
            -- and platform_name in ('鸿鹄','宏鹄') 
) as answer 
on broad.order_id = answer.order_id
and broad.base_driver_id = answer.driver_id
left join
(
    select
        shiftleft(shiftright(cast(orderid as bigint), 46)&262143, 32)+(cast(orderid  as bigint)&4294967295) as order_id,
        cpid,
        driver_id
    from
        kflower_ods.ods_log_kflower_g_order_dusepk_auction
    where
        concat_ws('-', year, month, day) between '2025-12-17' and '2025-12-24'
        and cast(cityid as bigint) < 1000 --过滤测试情况
        and process_order_status_ok = 'true'
        and process_winner_ok = 'true' --过滤异常情况
        and action = 'auction_time'
) as winner
on broad.order_id = winner.order_id
and broad.driver_id = winner.driver_id
inner join dri_tsh_type b
on broad.driver_id = b.driver_id
and broad.dt = b.dt
and broad.city_id = b.city_id
group by
b.exp_group
,broad.city_id
,right_type;

```
司机开关派单模式：
```sql
select  type
        ,switch_type
        ,count(driver_id) as dri_cnt
from    (
    select  *
    from    (
        select  distinct type
                ,switch_type
                ,driver_id
                ,timestamp
                ,concat_ws('-', year, month, day) as dt
                ,rank() over (partition by driver_id order by timestamp desc) as rn
        from    kflower_search.ods_log_honghu_g_driver_set_listen_mode_new_trade_rule_d
        where   concat_ws('-', year, month, day) = '${BIZ_DATE_LINE}'
          and   city_id = 58
    ) a
    where   rn = 1
)
group by type, switch_type
;

with
set_listen_mode as 
(
    select  *
    from    (
        select  distinct type
                ,switch_type
                ,driver_id
                ,timestamp
                ,concat_ws('-', year, month, day) as dt
                ,rank() over (partition by driver_id order by timestamp desc) as rn
        from    kflower_search.ods_log_honghu_g_driver_set_listen_mode_new_trade_rule_d
        where   concat_ws('-', year, month, day) = '${BIZ_DATE_LINE}'
          and   city_id = 58
    ) a
    where   rn = 1
)
,dri_type as 
(
    select  distinct dt
            ,driver_id
            ,city_id
            ,city_name
            ,company_id
            ,case   when company_id = 1400 then '自营'
                    when company_id <> 1400 then '宏鹄'
                    else null
             end as type
            ,case   when work_time_period_30d in ('240h+', '(200-240h]') then 2
                    when work_time_period_30d in ('(0-40h]', '(40-80h]', '(80-120h]') then 0
                    when work_time_period_30d in ('(160-200h]', '(120-160h]') then 1
                    else null
             end as tsh_type
            ,case   when right_type = 'default_driver' then '默认等级'
                    when right_type = 'full_time_driver' then '先锋司机/长期伙伴'
                    when right_type = 'semi_fulltime_driver' then '半全职'
                    when right_type = 'full_time_plus_driver' then '权益plus'
                    else null
             end as right_type
    from    kflower_app.dm_hh_dri_right_driver_detail_index_di
    where   dt = '${BIZ_DATE_LINE}'
      and   city_id in (58)
)
select  b.right_type
        ,a.type
        ,a.switch_type
        ,count(a.driver_id) as dri_cnt
from    set_listen_mode a
left join dri_type b
on      a.driver_id = b.driver_id
  and   a.dt = b.dt
group by b.right_type, a.type, a.switch_type
;


```
